critical_code_review_comments: routes/master.py CURRENT_VERSION is a module-level mutable global updated by publish_version — works in single-worker uvicorn but will drift across gunicorn workers. Read from settings.master_current_version on every read path (already done in update-check, but /status and /check still return the stale global 2.5.0). Recommend deriving CURRENT_VERSION dynamically from settings each request.

routes/master.py /relay/heartbeats iterates all licenses into an in-memory dict per request — for 1000+ licenses this becomes O(N) per hit. Add an index on licenses.license_key and do targeted find({'license_key': {'$in': [...]}} using the row set instead.

routes/master.py outdated_count in /relay/heartbeats compares plugin_version != CURRENT_VERSION (module global). After publish this global is updated in-process, but if request hits different worker before publish propagates, count is wrong. Same root cause as above — read from settings.

routes/maintenance.py /public/blocked-stats region='external' path does two full mail_events scans (up to 100k + 50k docs) with Python-side _ip_to_country — expensive. Precompute a country field at ingest-time and do a Mongo $match on country/verdict, or aggregate.

routes/master.py publish_version does not validate semver format of payload.version — a caller sending version='hax\n' would be stored verbatim and shown in changelog UI. Add regex validation ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$.
